ABOUT CAF

Not just a stop for coffee.

CAF presents itself as a social-driven specialty coffee bar — a place where the product, atmosphere and community all matter.

This demo keeps that identity intentionally minimal: monochrome, editorial, image-led and focused on the coffee.
